transcript: $150,000. That's what Dubai will reward you for building one AI agent that solves a real problem, and you can start with zero coding skills. This is the Create AI Agents Championship, a global competition launched by His Highness Sheikh Hamdan, the Crown Prince of Dubai, and organized by the Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy. Dubai used to run this as a championship for building apps, but this year they have reimagined the entire thing around AI agents because that is exactly where the world is heading. The concept is simple. You take a real problem, something genuinely broken in business, in everyday life, or across society, and you build an AI agent that solves it. There are four categories you can enter, including one built only for young founders under 21, and each category winner receives a $150,000 grant to grow their agent into a real business. Out of those four, one is crowned the Dubai AI Agent of the Year, the championship's highest honor, and takes home additional funding on top. Across all the categories, there is more than $750,000 in grants on the table, and you do not need to be an engineer to enter. There is no minimum age and no technical background required because the championship gives you the workshops, the mentorship, and the training to take your idea from a blank page to a working agent. Registration is now open. If you are interested in participating in this championship, comment the word AI agent right now, and I'll send you the official application link directly in your comments. You can also grab it from my bio and apply through the Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy website. Don't watch this one. This is the kind of thing people look back on and wish they'd entered.
